description:
Add two additive warn logs to saveReplay in src/v2/engine.ts to make ISS-015/ISS-012 repro attempts self-classifying at the renderer boundary. No behavior change.

1. Capture err in the bare catch {} and log the RPC rejection reason + code + v2State.
2. Add an else branch to the snapshot_id guard to log the no-snapshot_id path with result presence and v2State.

RESULT: Instrumentation deployed. Functional repro on first attempt (2026-05-24): new warn log fired with reason="no committed segments available to pin". ISS-015 classified as rolling-buffer seal failure. Stop condition met.
title: Add renderer-surface saveReplay failure reason classification log (ISS-015/ISS-012)
